scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run prisma:generate -w apps/backend && concurrently -n backend,frontend,types -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/frontend" "npm run dev -w packages/shared-types"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run prisma:generate -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/frontend
